name_note: GTDB splits the classical genus Coprococcus into several genera; the genomes placed in Coprococcus_C carry the NCBI names Clostridium, Coprococcus and Wujia.

sentences.text: Coprococcus is a butyrate-producing genus in the phylum Firmicutes.

A review reports that its abundance is inversely correlated with several neuropsychological and neurodegenerative disorders, and that case-control studies show decreased abundance of Coprococcus spp. in depressed individuals.
In faecal samples from 213 pregnant women, the abundance of the butyrate-producing Coprococcus genus significantly decreased in those who developed late-onset preeclampsia.
In that study, Coprococcus abundance was significantly and positively correlated with genes encoding the terminal step in bacterial butyrate formation.
